---
title: Compare Calibration Runs
echo: false
warning: false
message: false
---

Select any set of calibration runs to compare their headline validation
metrics side by side. Data comes from each run's `summary_metrics_*.json`
(one per stage, written by that stage's `.qmd` at render time — see
`report/README.md`), not from re-reading raw model output, so this page
stays fast regardless of how many calibration runs accumulate.

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# LOAD ALL PER-RUN, PER-STAGE SUMMARY METRICS
# ==============================================================================
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

rows = []
for f in sorted(Path(".").glob("summary_metrics_*.json")):
    with open(f) as fh:
        doc = json.load(fh)
    calib_run = doc.get("calib_run", "unknown")
    stage = doc.get("stage", f.stem.removeprefix("summary_metrics_"))
    for metric, value in doc.get("metrics", {}).items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        rows.append({"calib_run": calib_run, "stage": stage, "metric": metric, "value": value})

compare_df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["calib_run", "stage", "metric", "value"])
ojs_define(compare_data=compare_df)
```

```{ojs}
data = transpose(compare_data)
runsAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.calib_run))).sort()
stagesAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.stage))).sort()
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Compare

```{ojs}
//| panel: input

viewof selectedRuns = Inputs.checkbox(runsAvailable, {
  label: "Calibration Runs:",
  value: runsAvailable
})

viewof selectedStage = Inputs.select(stagesAvailable, {
  label: "Stage:",
  value: stagesAvailable[0]
})
```

```{ojs}
filtered = data.filter(d =>
  selectedRuns.includes(d.calib_run) && d.stage === selectedStage
)

metricsInStage = Array.from(new Set(filtered.map(d => d.metric)))
```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-compare-runs
//| fig-cap: "Headline metrics by calibration run"

filtered.length
  ? Plot.plot({
      grid: true,
      height: Math.max(260, metricsInStage.length * 220),
      marginLeft: 70,
      fy: { label: null, domain: metricsInStage },
      x: { label: "Calibration Run" },
      y: { label: "Value" },
      color: { legend: true, label: "Calibration Run" },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(filtered, {
          x: "calib_run",
          y: "value",
          fy: "metric",
          fill: "calib_run",
          tip: true
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
  : html`<p><em>No calibration runs have a summary_metrics_*.json for stage "${selectedStage}" yet.</em></p>`
```

## Data Table

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(filtered, {
  columns: ["calib_run", "stage", "metric", "value"],
  header: { calib_run: "Run", stage: "Stage", metric: "Metric", value: "Value" },
  sort: "calib_run",
  rows: 20
})
```
